exact_statement: For every fixed finite nonconstant gate table and ordered support covers satisfying the forests.tex interface, positive feasible lambda, nonempty covered set A and eligible assignment tau, let V be the used gates and c its number of source SCCs in the directed ownership-incidence graph, e=|V|-c, and b_tau=2^(-B_nonroot). Put w_uv(x)=sum_{j in A_u intersect R_v}x_(u,j) for u!=v and use incoming Laplacian L_vv=sum_u w_uv, L_vu=-w_uv. Let T_tau(x)=sum_{R selecting one root in each source SCC} product_{r in R}pi_r det L_(V\R,V\R)(x). For the monomial map M(product x^h)=product h!, the exact sum over distinct actual once-per-gate partition-forest queue runs with this assignment is sum_r 2^(-B(A;r))=b_tau M(T_tau). Different assignments are disjoint. With T_can=T_tau(1), D_(u,j)=number of eligible child gates at attachment group (u,j), a_D=(D+1)/2 for D>=1 and a_0=1, T_can<=M(T_tau)<=min(e!T_can,T_tau(a_D)). These determinant bounds are rational for rational pi, and can be summed with the separately algebraic b_tau to bound the full optimized residual cost -log2 sum_tau b_tau M(T_tau). T_tau factors into grounded non-source SCC determinants and rarity-weighted source-SCC cofactor sums, but its factorial-moment expectation need not factor across SCCs. The e! bound is sharp on positive-mass sunflower prime-table assignments. This computes the surrogate B mass, not exact queue probabilities, and asserts no universal O(I) or FEI bound.

initial roots and attachment-coordinate occurrences ordered deterministically by the fixed original generator; child labels at repeated attachment slots distinguish actual events
B is eq:forestcost, gamma=6/5, entropy and costs in bits, F in natural logs; failed and infinite runs contribute no output mass
rational determinant assertion conditional on rational rarity pi; algebraic b_tau is kept separate; no free output-dependent reference selection

exact_statement: For every nonconstant uniform Boolean read-once DNF consisting of m>=1 disjoint nonempty signed conjunction clauses of arbitrary widths w_l>=1, the original conditioned forests.tex generator with the exact prime-implicant table, lambda_l=1 and one fixed order per clause has one partition-forest run per nonempty set. Its complete source residual R is <=(16/5+log2(e))*I<47I/10. The actual conditioned probabilities of these finite once-per-block zero-child runs have full nonempty spectral cross-entropy C_pf<=(26/5+2log2(3)+2log2(e))*I. Including the empty/nonempty entropy split, h2(Var f)+C_pf<67I/5. These are ideal complete-reference costs, without optional binary-prefix rounding or optional mixture-selector charges, not a new FEI class or a universal PI-J bound.

exact_statement: For every fixed finite original forests.tex reference with positive feasible lambda, every nonempty covered A and eligible ownership assignment tau, let V be the used gates, s_u=|A_u|, g=|V|, a=|A|, e=g minus the number of original source SCCs, D=product_all(1+lambda_l*pi_l)-1, and t_u the original size/subset probability. Let T_tau be the incoming-Laplacian forest polynomial weighted by root pi over exactly one root per original source SCC. Define N_s(x^h)=product_u[product_(j in A_u)h_j!/((c_u+1)(c_u+2)*binom(s_u+c_u-1,c_u))], c_u=sum_(j in A_u)h_j. The exact conditioned mass of all distinct actual partition-forest events with this assignment and root restriction is Q_tau=product_used(lambda_u*t_u)*N_s(T_tau)/D. Assignments are disjoint, so Q_part=sum_tau Q_tau<=Q_* is a nonempty output subprobability. For independent per-gate triples B with density 2(1-b), rate-one exponential Y, and uniform simplex Z, N_s(T)=2^(-g)E T(BYZ). With factorial surrogate operator M, 2^(-(a+g+e))*3^(-e)*M(T)<=N_s(T)<=2^(-g)*M(T). Forced e-child sunflower prime assignments have T=pi*x^e and N_s(T)=pi*e!/((e+1)(e+2)*2^e), explicitly separating surrogate credit from complete queue probability. All label, root, subset, size, attachment, child-count and final-output ambiguity factors are retained; no universal O(I) or FEI bound is asserted.
